data.title: Cloud PMS - OPERA Cloud
data.description: Contributed to Oracle OPERA Cloud PMS used by 40K+ hotels globally. Built production-ready UI framework modules, reusable page templates, and REST integrations in a microservices ecosystem focused on reliability, scalability, and cross-region support.

data.title: JobBuddy
data.description: Built a local-first Gmail job-search dashboard that scans application emails with read-only Gmail access, classifies status signals, and turns inbox activity into a compact tracker for pipeline status, attention items, notes, and skill context.

data.title: Vortex AI
data.description: Built a RAG-based chatbot for querying PDF documents using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, and FAISS vector search. Designed an end-to-end workflow for indexing, semantic retrieval, and response generation to improve accuracy and usability for knowledge-heavy documents.

data.title: Online Video, Audio & PDF Editor
data.description: Developed secure browser-based media editing tools with 20+ features using FFmpeg (WASM) and PDF libraries. Focused on seamless client-side processing so user files remained local and private.

data.title: Policy Compliance System
data.description: Developed an RBAC-driven policy compliance platform with policy versioning, tracking workflows, notifications, and API integrations. Built for audit readiness and secure, role-based enterprise operations.

data.title: Order Management System
data.description: Built a PERN-based order and inventory management application with workflow support for multiple user roles. Implemented secure APIs and structured data operations for improved traceability and operational control.
